{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS quarter,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), piv AS (
  SELECT cat,
         SUM(CASE WHEN quarter='Q1' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS q1_gmv,
         SUM(CASE WHEN quarter='Q2' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS q2_gmv
  FROM q GROUP BY cat
), both AS (
  SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff
  FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff < 0) AS declining_categories,
       COUNT(*) AS compared_categories,
       (SELECT cat FROM both WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_category,
       (SELECT diff FROM both WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_amount
FROM both;"}
